result:
The proposed answer of 10 is not correct.

The solution's classification is wrong. The automorphism group of a quadratic rational map is trivial, C₂, or S₃ (= D₃), so the groups D₄, D₆ and A₄ never occur. In particular there is no "A₄ map" that could attain 10 preperiodic points.

I did not derive the correct maximum here. From memory of the literature on Q-rational preperiodic points of quadratic maps with nontrivial automorphism group (Doyle and coauthors), the maximum for nonabelian automorphism group (S₃) is 9. I am recalling this rather than checking it, but either way the claimed reasoning and the value 10 do not hold.

VERDICT: REJECT
